newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Heavy rains kill three in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Heavy rains kill three in Brazil.

text.p: Three people were killed and at least 10 injured as a result of heavy rains in the city of Nova Friburgo in Brazil's Rio de Janeiro state, a police spokesman said on Thursday.
Three people drowned in their homes on Wednesday night when the river Bengala, which runs through Nova Friburgo, flooded the houses along its banks, the spokesman said.
He said the heavy rains lasted about 90 minutes and the river swept away several houses. The injured were taken to a local hospital.
